messages:
Anika (CS): Pelotonix wants to onboard a custom 13B summarizer for PHI-containing clinical notes. They asked for private deployment + HSM, and flagged renewal in ~6w — potential expand if latency <250ms. Need safety/eval plan and canary playbook.
Devon (SE): Got it. Do they have a model artifact or do they want Redwood-managed variant? Also: quantized q4 intent?
Anika (CS): Pelotonix POC said they have a fine-tuned 13B in GGML format, planning q4_0. Asked for rollback & data retention controls.
Ben (Ops): From infra side, private VPC + HSM is doable. Baseline capacity: 2xA10G for perf testing, recommend reserved burst for canary. HSM provisioning will take ~3 business days.
Eva (Product): Renewal risk flagged — recommend an enablement demo + exec perf summary to secure renewal. Also collect 3 target prompts and failure modes they care about.
Sam (QA): I'll put together an eval harness. Proposal: 200 PHI examples, 50 edge/adversarial prompts, tests for entity redaction (PHI leakage), hallucination rate, and latency p50/p95.
Anika (CS): They requested 99.9% uptime SLA for the private deployment and weekly check-ins for month 1. Also asked about canary % and monitoring hooks.
Devon (SE): Proposed test plan (short):
```
1) offline safety run (PHI filter + rouge/halluc tests)
2) private infra soak (24-48h)
3) canary 5% traffic, 24h, observe phi_leak and hallucination_rate
4) ramp to 25% then 100% if green
config:
model: pelotonix-13b-q4
routing: private-vpc
canary: 5% traffic, 24h
metrics: latency_p95, phi_leak, hallucination_rate
```
Ben (Ops): I'll create the VPC peering and start HSM ticket. ETA: provisioning + network rules in 3 days, canary infra ready after that.
Anika (CS): I'll draft the SOW items (retention, contract SLOs, contacts) and schedule the kickoff with Pelotonix for Thursday 2pm PT.
Eva (Product): Also add Redwood Optimize run to recommend quantization profile; capture cost/latency delta. That helps the exec ROI slide for renewal.
Devon (SE): Agree. I'll run Optimize on a sample corpus and share numbers. Also preparing a rollback runbook (how to switch back to hosted variant).
Sam (QA): I'll prepare the eval dataset + tox tests and push artifacts to the shared drive: /redwood/internal/evals/pelotonix. Will include seed prompts and PHI redaction thresholds.
deploy-bot: Job queued -> job 98765
deploy-bot: Job 98765 started on infra-ops-14
Ben (Ops): Noted. I'll watch the job and enable alerting for phi_leak > 0.1% and latency_p95 > 300ms.
Anika (CS): Pelotonix asked for weekly status reports for month 1; I confirmed. I'll also capture their enablement attendees so we can tailor the demo.
Devon (SE): Link to internal onboarding checklist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-541 
Sam (QA): Remind: include fuzz tests for prompt injection and a small human-in-the-loop review for first 500 outputs.
Eva (Product): Owners: Anika - customer comms & SOW; Devon - tech lead & rollback; Ben - infra & HSM; Sam - evals & safety.
Anika (CS): Meeting set Thu 2pm PT. I'll ping pelotonix-poc with next steps after we have provisioning ETA. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Devon (SE): I'll produce the canary runbook pre-meeting.
Ben (Ops): Starting infra tickets and HSM request now.
Sam (QA): Uploading initial eval skeleton in 30min.
Anika (CS): Closing loop — I'll update renewal risk tracker and add note about potential upsell if perf targets met.
